## Validation

## Release intent

Releases are derived from the Conventional Commits in this pull request. Merge
commits are used, so every individual commit subject matters.

- [ ] Release-worthy changes use `fix`, `perf`, `feat`, or a breaking marker.
- [ ] Changes that do not affect a published module use a non-releasing type.
